# cloudnativepg

Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project cloudnativepg --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project cloudnativepg`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project cloudnativepg --current-resource FILE --resource FILE --from 1.29.0 --to 1.30.0 (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--current-resource-digest SHA256] [--resource-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project cloudnativepg --input FILE --from 1.29.0 --to 1.30.0 [--input-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
